name: Wynaut
description: It tends to move in a pack. Individuals squash against one another to toughen their spirits.

moves.name: Counter
moves.description: A retaliation move that counters any physical attack, inflicting double the damage taken.

moves.name: Amnesia
moves.description: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This sharply raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Splash
moves.description: The user just flops and splashes around to no effect at all...

moves.name: Destiny Bond
moves.description: After using this move, if the user faints, the Pokémon that landed the knockout hit also faints. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Charm
moves.description: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. This harshly lowers the target’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Safeguard
moves.description: The user creates a protective field that prevents status conditions for five turns.

moves.name: Encore
moves.description: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.

moves.name: Mirror Coat
moves.description: A retaliation move that counters any special attack, inflicting double the damage taken.
